name: clip-to-cash
title_zh: 主播爆款切片从发现到发布的全自动流水线
tagline_zh: 粘贴一个主播链接，自动完成找高光、二次剪辑、配两行情绪钩子字幕、生成可发布文件。你只管上传，收益归你。
tagline_en: Paste a streamer link, get a re-cut clip with emotional 2-line captions, ready to post and monetize. You just.
desc_en: End-to-end workflow that takes a viral streamer post found by ClipVein and turns it into a re-cut, re-captioned clip ready to post and monetize. Use when you have a link (or a ClipVein result) and want the full "found moment → posted clip → paid" loop, including caption generation in the two-line emotional-bait format.
why_zh: 不是单点工具，而是把「发现→剪辑→文案→成品」串成闭环。字幕按两行情绪钩子格式生成。
why_en: Not a single-step tool—it closes the loop from discovery to finished clip. Captions follow a 2-line emotional-bait format built.
limit_zh: 只认 ClipVein 找到的直播片段链接；不处理本地视频文件。产物是带字幕的成片，不含发布动作。
limit_en: Only accepts ClipVein-found stream links, not local files. Output is a captioned clip—no posting, no monetization settlement.
title_en: Auto pipeline: viral clip found → re-cut → posted
